Implementation starts only after the W5 (add-viewport-layout-sweep) implementation merges to main (ladder sequencing); the pack-tagging group additionally gates on the W4 (add-scenario-packs) implementation landing.

allowedActiveChanges.name: harden-gm-two-player-campaign-sessions
allowedActiveChanges.reason: User-approved declarative-first change for one non-playing GM plus two tactical players: durable command journaling and publication, role-safe live/replay/export projection, reconnect cursors, outcome receipts, append-only correction and rewind, campaign retroactive rebuild, and a strict 80-scenario three-context acceptance program. Implementation is intentionally split into small independently verified PRs with exact-main post-merge regression audits. Its e2e-testing delta adds distinct GM/two-player requirements and does not modify the active add-subsystem-lanes-and-ci requirement names.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-replay-schema-and-checkpoint-safety

Implementation started: spec PRs #1120/#1124 and registry/upcaster kernel PR 1A (#1125) merged with exact-main receipts; PR 1B (pipeline fingerprint) is admitted and next.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-authority-audit-and-privacy-proof

allowedActiveChanges.name: adopt-combat-event-journal-authority

allowedActiveChanges.name: adopt-campaign-event-journal-authority
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 5 of the entity-history program: adopt the shared journal as campaign authority through atomic commands, honest snapshot migration, durable entity lineage, gap-free replay/live handoff, participant cursors, and per-campaign cutover.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-cross-stream-effect-receipts
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 6 of the entity-history program: add target-scoped transactional outbox/inbox receipts, side-effect-free replay, causal cross-stream history, and exactly-once combat-to-campaign effect application over at-least-once delivery.

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-authoritative-history-branches
allowedActiveChanges.reason: Wave 7 of the entity-history program: add immutable branch lineage, verified replacement-branch activation, domain-command revalidation instead of generic merge, and recoverable combat/campaign correction sagas after linear authority and effect receipts are proven.
